import torch, json
ts_model = torch.jit.load('terramechanics_surrogate.pt')
meta = json.load(open('surrogate_metadata.json'))
lo_x = torch.tensor(meta['norm_x_lo'])
hi_x = torch.tensor(meta['norm_x_hi'])
lo_y = torch.tensor(meta['norm_y_lo'])
hi_y = torch.tensor(meta['norm_y_hi'])
x = torch.tensor([[slip, sinkage_m]])
x_n = 2*(x-lo_x)/(hi_x-lo_x).clamp(1e-12) - 1
with torch.no_grad(): y_n = ts_model(x_n)
y = (y_n+1)*(hi_y-lo_y)/2 + lo_y
Fx, Fz, My = y[0,0].item(), y[0,1].item(), y[0,2].item()
